sentences.zh: 開平四年十月乙亥，東京博王友文入覲，召之也。

translations.literal: On yihai, tenth month of Kaiping 4, Prince of Bo Youwen of the Eastern Capital came to audience—it was a summons.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the tenth month of Kaiping 4, Prince of Bo Youwen at the Eastern Capital entered court; he had been summoned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以新修天驥院開宴落成，內外並獻馬，而魏博進絹四萬匹為駔價。

translations.literal: On jimao, because the newly repaired Heavenly Steeds Park held a feast for its completion, inside and outside alike presented horses, and Weibo sent forty thousand bolts of silk as stud price.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, to mark completion of the newly rebuilt Heavenly Steeds Park, court and country presented horses; Weibo sent forty thousand bolts of silk as stud fees.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以冬設禁軍，幸興安鞠場，召文武百官宴。

translations.literal: On renwu, because winter was setting in for the Palace Army, he visited Xing’an Ball Ground and summoned civil and military officials to a feast.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, with winter drill for the Palace Army, he went to Xing’an Ball Ground and feasted the full civil and military establishment.

sentences.zh: 幸開化，大閱軍實。

translations.literal: He visited Kaihua and conducted a great review of military stores.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Kaihua and held a grand inspection of arms and stores.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，幸廣王第作樂。

translations.literal: On dinghai, first day of the eleventh month, he visited the Prince of Guang’s residence for music.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the first of the eleventh month, he went to the Prince of Guang’s mansion for music.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，宴文武四品已上于宣威殿。

translations.literal: On xinmao he feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he gave civil and military officials of fourth rank and above a feast at Xuanwei Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸左龍虎軍，宴群臣。

translations.literal: On gengxu he visited the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he went to the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸右龍虎軍，宴群臣。

translations.literal: On jiayin he visited the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he went to the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted the ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「自朔至今，暴風未息，諒惟不德，致此咎征。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict stated: "From the new moon until now violent winds have not ceased—I alone lack virtue and have brought on this ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict read: "Since the new moon, violent winds have not stopped. I alone lack virtue and have drawn down this portent.

sentences.zh: 皇天動威，罔敢不懼。

translations.literal: Heaven has shown its wrath; who would not fear?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has stirred its might; none may fail to fear.

sentences.zh: 宜遍命祈禱，副朕意焉。

translations.literal: Prayers should be ordered everywhere to accord with my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let prayers be ordered throughout the realm to match my intent."

sentences.zh: 」差官分往祠所止風。

translations.literal: " Officials were dispatched separately to shrines to halt the wind.
translations.idiomatic: " Envoys were sent to various shrines to pray for the wind to cease.

sentences.zh: 己亥，日南至，帝被袞冕禦朝元殿，列細仗，奏樂於庭，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: On jihai, the winter solstice, the Emperor donned ceremonial robes and presided at Chaoyuan Hall, arrayed the detailed guard, music played in the courtyard, and the ministers offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the winter solstice, the Emperor wore full regalia at Chaoyuan Hall, drew up the detailed guard, had music in the courtyard, and received congratulations from the ministers.

sentences.zh: 帝畋于伊水。

translations.literal: The Emperor hunted on the Yi River.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor hunted along the Yi River.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「關防者，所以識異服、察異言也。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict stated: "Frontier posts exist to recognize alien dress and detect alien speech.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict read: "Frontier posts exist to spot foreign dress and foreign speech.

sentences.zh: 況下天未息，兵民多奸，改形易衣，覘我戎事。

translations.literal: Moreover the realm is not yet at peace and soldiers and people are full of treachery—they change their appearance and clothes to spy on our military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The realm is still unsettled and soldiers and civilians are rife with deceit; they disguise themselves to spy on our armies.

sentences.zh: 比者有諜皆以詐敗，而未嘗罪所過地，叛將逃卒竊其妻孥而影附使者，亦未嘗詰其所經。

translations.literal: Lately spies have all been exposed by fraud, yet the places they passed through were never punished; rebel generals and fugitive soldiers stole away wives and children and shadowed envoys, yet where they traveled was never investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Lately every spy has been caught by trickery, yet the districts they passed through went unpunished; defecting officers and runaway soldiers stole families and trailed behind envoys, yet no one questioned their route.

sentences.zh: 今海內未同，而緩法弛禁，非所以息奸詐、止奔亡也。

translations.literal: Now the realm is not yet united, yet laws are slack and prohibitions loose—this is no way to end fraud or stop flight.
translations.idiomatic: The empire is not yet one, yet the law is lax and the gates open—no way to curb deceit or stop desertion.

sentences.zh: 應在京諸司，不得擅給公驗。

translations.literal: All offices in the capital must not issue official passes on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: No capital agency may issue travel passes on its own.

sentences.zh: 如有出外須執憑由者，其司門過所，先須經中書門下點檢，宜委宰臣趙光逢專判出給，俾由顯重，冀絕奸源。

translations.literal: If anyone going out must carry credentials, the Gate Office travel permit must first be inspected by the Secretariat-Chancellery; chief minister Zhao Guangfeng should be charged solely with issuing them, so that the route is weighty and the source of treachery cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone leaving the capital with papers must have Gate Office permits checked first by the Secretariat-Chancellery; chief minister Zhao Guangfeng alone should issue them, so the trail is weighty and treachery choked at the source.

sentences.zh: 仍下兩京、河陽及六軍諸衛、御史台，各加鈐轄。

translations.literal: The order was also sent to the two capitals, Heyang, the Six Armies guards, and the Censorate, each to tighten control.
translations.idiomatic: The same order went to both capitals, Heyang, the Six Armies guards, and the Censorate to tighten oversight.

sentences.zh: 公私行李，復不得帶挾家口向西。

translations.literal: Private and official baggage again must not carry family members westward.
translations.idiomatic: Private and official baggage might no longer take dependents west.

sentences.zh: 其襄、鄧、鄜、延等道，並同處分。

translations.literal: The Xiang, Deng, Fu, and Yan circuits were to be handled the same way.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiang, Deng, Fu, and Yan circuits received the same rules.

sentences.zh: 」以甯國軍節度使王景仁充北面行營都招討使，潞州副招討使韓勍為副，相州刺史李思安為先鋒使。

translations.literal: " Ningguo military commissioner Wang Jingren was made overall northern campaign commander; Luzhou deputy commander Han Qin was his second; Xiangzhou prefect Li Si’an was vanguard commander.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Jingren, Ningguo commissioner, became overall northern campaign commander; Han Qin, Luzhou deputy, his second; Li Si’an, Xiangzhou prefect, vanguard.

sentences.zh: 時鎮州王熔、定州王處直叛，結連晉人，故遣將討之。

translations.literal: At the time Zhenzhou’s Wang Rong and Dingzhou’s Wang Chuzhi had rebelled and allied with the Jin, so generals were sent to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong of Zhenzhou and Wang Chuzhi of Dingzhou had rebelled and joined the Jin, so troops were sent against them.

sentences.zh: 《五代會要》：十一月十四日，司天奏：「月蝕，不宜用兵。

translations.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: On the fourteenth of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy reported: "A lunar eclipse—war should not be waged.
translations.idiomatic: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: On the fourteenth of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy memorialized: "There will be a lunar eclipse; it is inauspicious to use arms.

sentences.zh: 」時王景仁方總大軍北伐，追之不及。

translations.literal: " At the time Wang Jingren was already leading the great army north; the recall could not reach him in time.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Jingren was already at the head of the main northern force; the recall did not overtake him.

sentences.zh: 至五年正月二日，果為後唐莊宗大敗于柏鄉。

translations.literal: By the second of the first month of year five he was indeed routed at Baixiang by Later Tang’s Zhuangzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the second of the first month of the fifth year he was indeed crushed at Baixiang by Zhuangzong of Later Tang.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，宴文武四品已上于宣威殿。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the twelfth month he feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the twelfth month he feasted officials of fourth rank and above at Xuanwei Hall.

sentences.zh: 親閱禁軍，命格鬥于教馬亭。

translations.literal: He personally reviewed the Palace Army and ordered grappling at Jiaoma Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He personally inspected the Palace Army and ordered hand-to-hand drill at Jiaoma Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔曰：「滑、宋、輝、亳等州，水澇敗傷，人戶愁歎，朕為民父母，良用痛心。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict stated: "Hua, Song, Hui, and Bo prefectures have suffered flood damage; households groan in distress—as parent to the people I am deeply pained.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict read: "Hua, Song, Hui, and Bo have been ruined by floods; the people lament. As their parent, I am deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 其令本州分等級賑貸，所在長吏監臨周給，務令存濟。

translations.literal: Let each prefecture grade and lend relief grain; local magistrates shall supervise thorough distribution and strive to keep the people alive.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture should grade households and lend relief; local magistrates must oversee full distribution and keep people alive.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，賑貸東都畿內，如宋、滑制。

translations.literal: " On renchen relief was lent within the Eastern Capital metropolitan belt, following the Song and Hua rules.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen relief was extended within the Eastern Capital region on the Song and Hua model.

sentences.zh: 乾化元年正月丙戌朔，日有食之，帝素服避殿，百官守司以恭天事，明復而止。

translations.literal: On bingxu, first day of the first month of Ganhua 1, there was an eclipse; the Emperor wore plain robes and avoided the hall, officials kept their posts to honor Heaven, and when brightness returned they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, New Year’s Day of Ganhua 1, an eclipse occurred; the Emperor wore plain dress and stayed off the throne, officials kept their posts in reverence for Heaven, and when the light returned they resumed.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「兩漢以來，日食地震，百官各上封事，指陳得失。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Since the two Han dynasties, at solar eclipses and earthquakes all officials submitted sealed memorials pointing out gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Since Han times, at eclipses and earthquakes every official has submitted sealed memorials on what is right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 蓋欲周知時病，盡達物情，用緝國章，以奉天誡。

translations.literal: The aim was to know the age’s ills thoroughly, convey all conditions, knit the state’s laws, and honor Heaven’s warning.
translations.idiomatic: The aim was to know the times’ ills, convey every grievance, mend the state’s laws, and heed Heaven’s warning.

sentences.zh: 朕每思逆耳，罔忌觸鱗，將洽政經，庶開言路。

translations.literal: I always welcome words that sting the ear and do not fear touching the scales; I wish to align governance and open the path of speech.
translations.idiomatic: I have always welcomed blunt counsel and do not fear offending; I mean to set policy straight and open the road of remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 況茲謫見，當有咎征。

translations.literal: Moreover this reprimand in the sky surely has a portent behind it.
translations.idiomatic: This rebuke in the heavens surely marks some fault below.

sentences.zh: 其在列辟群臣，危言正諫，極萬邦之利害，致六合之殷昌。

translations.literal: Let all feudal lords and ministers speak harsh truth and straight remonstrance, exhaust the realm’s harm and benefit, and bring the six directions to abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Let every lord and minister speak harsh truth, lay bare the realm’s harms and gains, and bring the four quarters to prosperity.

sentences.zh: 毗予一人，永建皇極。

translations.literal: Assist me alone and forever establish the supreme pole."
translations.idiomatic: Stand with me and long uphold the throne."

sentences.zh: 」二日，日旁有祲氣，向背若環耳。

translations.literal: " On the second day there was a baleful aura beside the sun, front and back like a ring.
translations.idiomatic: " On the second day a sinister halo ringed the sun fore and aft.

sentences.zh: 崇政使敬翔望之曰：「兵可憂矣！

translations.literal: Chongzheng commissioner Jing Xiang, observing it, said: "The army is to be feared!"
translations.idiomatic: Jing Xiang, Chongzheng commissioner, watching it, said: "The armies are in peril!"

sentences.zh: 」帝為之旰食。

translations.literal: " The Emperor lost his appetite over it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor could not eat for worry.

sentences.zh: 是日，果為晉軍及鎮、定之師所敗，都將十餘人被擒，餘眾奔潰。

translations.literal: That very day he was indeed defeated by the Jin army and the Zhen and Ding forces; more than ten commanders were captured and the rest fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: That day he was indeed beaten by the Jin and the Zhen and Ding armies; a dozen commanders were taken and the rest broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，制曰：「扈氏不恭，固難去戰，鬼方未服，尚或勞師。

translations.literal: On gengyin an edict stated: "The Hu clan was unruly—it was hard to leave off war; the Guifang were not yet subdued—troops might still be wearied.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict read: "The Hu were unruly and war was hard to end; Guifang had not submitted and armies were still worn.

sentences.zh: 其蟻聚餘妖，狐鳴丑類，棄天常而拒命，據地險以偷生，言事討除，將期戡定。

translations.literal: These ant-swarm remnants and fox-crying rabble abandoned Heaven’s constant and defied orders, held rugged ground and clung to life—when we speak of punishing them, we expect soon to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: These swarming remnants and yelping rabble defied Heaven, held rough country, and clung to life; the campaign to crush them should soon succeed.

sentences.zh: 問罪止誅於元惡，挺災可憫于遺黎，每念傷痍，良深愧歎。

translations.literal: When asking guilt, punish only the chief villains; when disaster strikes, pity the survivors—I think constantly of the wounded and sigh in deep shame.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment should fall on ringleaders alone; when calamity spreads, pity the people left behind. I brood on the harm done and sigh in shame.

sentences.zh: 應天兵所至之地，宜令將帥節級嚴戒軍伍，不得焚燒廬舍，開發丘壟，毀廢農桑，驅掠士女。

translations.literal: Wherever the imperial army goes, commanders should strictly warn their troops: they must not burn houses, open tombs, ruin farming, or drive off men and women.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the imperial army marches, commanders must strictly forbid troops to burn homes, open graves, ruin crops, or seize men and women.

sentences.zh: 使其背叛之俗，知予吊伐之心。

translations.literal: Let the rebel country know my heart in coming to comfort and punish.
translations.idiomatic: Let rebel lands know that I come to punish the guilty and comfort the people.

sentences.zh: 」又制曰：「戎機方切，國用未殷，養兵須藉於賦租，稅粟尚煩於力役。

translations.literal: " Another edict stated: "Military urgency is pressing and the treasury is not full—soldiers must be fed from tax grain, and grain tax still burdens corvée.
translations.idiomatic: " Another edict read: "War is urgent and the treasury thin—armies live on tax grain, yet levies still press the people.

sentences.zh: 所在長吏，不得因緣徵發，自務貪求，苟有故違，必行重典。

translations.literal: Local magistrates must not use the occasion to levy extra and seek their own greed; if anyone knowingly violates this, heavy law will be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Local magistrates must not use the crisis to levy more and line their pockets; violators will face the severest penalties.

sentences.zh: 立法垂制，詳刑定科，傳之無窮，守而勿失。

translations.literal: To establish law and hand down systems, to detail punishments and fix statutes—transmit them without end and keep them without loss.
translations.idiomatic: Laws and systems, punishments and statutes—let them be handed down forever and kept without fail.

sentences.zh: 中書門下所奏新定格式律令，已頒下中外，各委所在長吏，切務遵行。

translations.literal: The newly fixed formats, statutes, and ordinances reported by the Secretariat-Chancellery have been issued inside and outside; each local magistrate must earnestly obey.
translations.idiomatic: The new formats, statutes, and ordinances from the Secretariat-Chancellery are promulgated everywhere; every local magistrate must obey them.

sentences.zh: 盡革煩苛，皆除枉濫，用副哀矜之旨，無違欽恤之言。

translations.literal: Cut all harsh excess, remove all wrongful abuse, to match the intent of compassion and not betray the charge of merciful judgment."
translations.idiomatic: Cut harshness and wrongful abuse, to match compassionate rule and honor merciful judgment."

sentences.zh: 」詔征陝州鎮國軍節度使楊師厚至京，見於崇勳殿。

translations.literal: " An edict summoned Shaanxi Zhenguo military commissioner Yang Shihou to the capital; he was received at Chongxun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: " Yang Shihou, Zhenguo commissioner of Shaanxi, was summoned to court and received at Chongxun Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝指授方略，依前充北面都招討使，恩賚甚厚，使督軍進發。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally set strategy; as before he was made overall northern commander; favors were very generous and he was sent to supervise the army’s advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor laid out strategy in person, reappointed him overall northern commander, heaped rewards on him, and sent him to lead the advance.

sentences.zh: 《五代會要》：二月，晉師侵魏州，楊師厚帥師援邢州，晉人還師。

translations.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month Jin troops raided Weizhou; Yang Shihou led troops to relieve Xingzhou and the Jin withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month Jin forces struck Weizhou; Yang Shihou marched to relieve Xingzhou and the Jin pulled back.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰朔，帝御文明殿，群臣入閣。

translations.literal: On bingchen, first day of the second month, the Emperor presided at Wenhua Hall and the ministers entered the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the first of the second month, the Emperor held Wenhua Hall and the ministers entered the side hall.

sentences.zh: 以蔡州順化軍指揮使王存儼權知軍州事。

translations.literal: Wang Cunyan, commander of Shunhua Army at Cai Prefecture, was made acting military prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Cunyan, Shunhua Army commander at Cai, was made acting prefect and military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 蔡人久習叛逆，刺史張慎思又裒斂無狀，帝追慎思至京，而久未命代。

translations.literal: The people of Cai had long been used to rebellion; prefect Zhang Shensi also extorted without restraint; the Emperor recalled Shensi to the capital but for a long time appointed no replacement.
translations.idiomatic: Cai had long bred rebels; Prefect Zhang Shensi extorted without limit. The Emperor recalled Shensi to court but left the post empty for months.

sentences.zh: 右廂指揮使劉行琮乘虛作亂，因縱火驅擁，為渡淮計。

translations.literal: Right-wing commander Liu Xingcong seized the moment to rebel, set fires to drive the crowd, and planned to cross the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Right-wing commander Liu Xingcong seized the gap to revolt, set fires to drive the mob, and aimed to cross the Huai.

sentences.zh: 存儼誅行琮而撫遏其眾，都將鄭遵與其下奉存儼為主，而以眾情馳奏。

translations.literal: Cunyan killed Xingcong and pacified the troops; commander Zheng Zun and his men made Cunyan leader and galloped a memorial on the army’s will.
translations.idiomatic: Cunyan killed Xingcong and calmed the host; Commander Zheng Zun and the men raised Cunyan and raced a memorial on the army’s choice.

sentences.zh: 時東京留守博王友文不先請，遂討其亂。

translations.literal: At the time Eastern Capital regent Prince of Bo Youwen did not ask first but set out to suppress the disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Prince of Bo Youwen marched to crush the revolt without waiting for orders.

sentences.zh: 兵至鄢陵，上聞之曰：「誅行琮功也，然存儼方懼，若臨之以兵，蔡必速飛矣！

translations.literal: When the army reached Yanling the sovereign heard and said: "Killing Xingcong is merit—but Cunyan is still afraid; if we press him with troops, Cai will flee at once!"
translations.idiomatic: At Yanling the Emperor heard and said: "Killing Xingcong is merit, but Cunyan is terrified; if we march on him in force, Cai will bolt overnight!"

sentences.zh: 」遂馳使還軍，而擢授存儼，蔡人安之。

translations.literal: " He immediately sent orders to recall the army, promoted Cunyan, and the people of Cai were reassured.
translations.idiomatic: " He at once recalled the army, promoted Cunyan, and Cai settled down.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「東京舊邦，久不巡幸，宜以今月九日幸東都，扈從文武官委中書門下量閑劇處分。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict stated: "The Eastern Capital is our old seat and long unvisited; on the ninth of this month I should visit the Eastern Capital; civil and military followers are to be assigned by the Secretariat-Chancellery according to urgency.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict read: "The Eastern Capital is our ancient seat and long neglected; I shall visit it on the ninth of this month. Civil and military followers will be assigned by the Secretariat-Chancellery by priority.

sentences.zh: 」宰臣上言曰：「龍興天府，久望法駕，但陛下始康愈，未宜涉寒，願少留清蹕。

translations.literal: " The chief ministers memorialized: "The dragon rises in the heavenly seat and long awaits your chariot—but Your Majesty has only just recovered and should not brave the cold; we beg you to linger a while longer.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief ministers said: "The Eastern Capital has long awaited your presence, but you have only just recovered and should not brave the cold; we beg a little more time.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " He assented.
translations.idiomatic: " He agreed.

sentences.zh: 《五代會要》：二月，敕：「食人之食者，憂人之事，況丞相尊位，參決大政，而堂封未給，且無餐錢，朕甚愧之。

translations.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month an order stated: "Those who eat the people’s food should worry over the people’s affairs—how much more the chancellor’s exalted post, deciding great policy, yet hall stipend unpaid and no meal money—I am deeply ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: In the second month an order read: "Those fed by the state should care for its business—how much more the chancellor, who decides great affairs, yet receives no hall stipend and no meal allowance. I am ashamed.

sentences.zh: 宜令食萬錢之半。

translations.literal: They should be granted half of ten thousand cash in food allowance.
translations.idiomatic: Let them receive half the usual ten-thousand-cash meal allowance.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸曜村民舍閱農事。

translations.literal: On jiazi he visited a farmhouse at Yaocun to inspect farming.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he visited a farmhouse at Yaocun to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸白馬坡。

translations.literal: On gengwu he visited Baima Slope.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he went to Baima Slope.

sentences.zh: 詔金吾大將軍、待制官各奏事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Commandant of the Gold Crow and awaiting-appointment officials each to memorialize on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict required the Commandant of the Gold Crow and awaiting-appointment officials each to report on affairs.

sentences.zh: 武安軍節度使馬殷進呈虔州刺史盧延昌箋表。

translations.literal: Wuan military commissioner Ma Yin presented the memorial and petition of Qianzhou prefect Lu Yanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yin, Wuan commissioner, presented the memorial and petition of Lu Yanchang, Qianzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 虔州本支郡也，兵甚銳，自得韶州益強大，升為百勝軍使。

translations.literal: Qianzhou was originally a branch prefecture with very sharp troops; since taking Shaozhou it grew stronger and was promoted to commander of the Hundred Victories Army.
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhou had been a subordinate prefecture with fierce troops; after Shaozhou it grew stronger and was raised to Hundred Victories Army commander.

sentences.zh: 始洪州之陷，盧光稠願收復使府，立功自效，上因兼授江西觀察留後。

translations.literal: When Hongzhou first fell, Lu Guangchou wished to recover the commissioner’s seat and earn merit; the sovereign therefore also made him Jiangxi observation commissioner on probation.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongzhou fell, Lu Guangchou sought to retake the seat and prove himself; the Emperor therefore named him acting Jiangxi observation commissioner as well.

sentences.zh: 光稠卒，復命延昌領州事，方伯亦頗慰薦。

translations.literal: When Guangchou died, Yanchang was again ordered to hold the prefecture; the regional commissioner also recommended him warmly.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangchou died, Yanchang was again put in charge of the prefecture; the regional commissioner strongly recommended him.

sentences.zh: 楊渭遣人偽署爵秩，延昌佯受官牒，禮遣其使，因湖南自表其事曰：「郡小寇迫，欲緩其奸謀，且開導貢路，非敢貳也。

translations.literal: Yang Wei sent men to forge titles of rank; Yanchang pretended to accept the commission, courteously sent the envoys off, and through Hunan memorialized himself: "The prefecture is small and bandits press close—I wish to slow their plots and keep the tribute road open; I do not dare to turn disloyal.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wei sent men to grant forged ranks; Yanchang feigned acceptance, courteously dismissed the envoys, and through Hunan reported: "Our district is small and rebels close in—I mean to stall their plots and keep tribute moving; I do not mean to defect.

sentences.zh: 」以其偽制來自陳，上覽奏曰：「我方有北事，不可不甚加撫恤。

translations.literal: " He came forward with the forged commission; reading the memorial the sovereign said: "We have northern business and cannot fail to treat him generously.
translations.idiomatic: " He presented the forged patent; reading the memorial the Emperor said: "With northern war on hand we must treat him generously.

sentences.zh: 」尋兼授鎮南將軍節度使觀察留後，命使慰勞。

translations.literal: " Soon he was also made Zhennan general, military commissioner, and observation commissioner on probation, and envoys were sent to console him.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon he was also named Zhennan general, military commissioner, and acting observation commissioner, and envoys were sent to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 《九國志》：盧延昌歸命于吳，偽乞命于梁。

translations.literal: 《Nine States Annals》: Lu Yanchang submitted to Wu while falsely begging office from Liang.
translations.idiomatic: 《Nine States Annals》: Lu Yanchang submitted to Wu while pretending to seek office from Liang.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，以久旱，令宰臣分禱靈跡。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the third month, because of long drought, he ordered chief ministers to pray separately at numinous sites.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the third month, after long drought, he sent chief ministers to pray at sacred sites in turn.

sentences.zh: 翼日，大澍雨。

translations.literal: The next day there was a great soaking rain.
translations.idiomatic: The next day came a soaking rain.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸甘水亭，召宰臣、翰林學士、尚書侍郎孔續已下八人扈從，宴樂甚歡。

translations.literal: On bingshen he visited Ganshui Pavilion, summoned chief ministers, Hanlin academicians, and Vice Minister of the Secretariat Kong Xu and seven others below him to attend, and feasted with great joy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen at Ganshui Pavilion he took chief ministers, Hanlin scholars, and Vice Minister Kong Xu and seven others in attendance and feasted with great delight.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸右龍虎軍，召文武官四品已上宴於新殿。

translations.literal: On wuxu he visited the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and summoned civil and military officials of fourth rank and above to feast in the new hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he went to the Right Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted officials of fourth rank and above in the new hall.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸左龍虎軍新殿，宴文武官四品已上。

translations.literal: On jiachen he visited the new hall of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army and feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he went to the Left Dragon-Tiger Army’s new hall and feasted officials of fourth rank and above.

sentences.zh: 四月丁卯，幸龍虎門，召宰臣、學士、金吾上將軍、大將軍侍宴廣化寺。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the fourth month he visited Longhu Gate, summoned chief ministers, academicians, senior generals of the Gold Crow, and great generals to attend a feast at Guanghua Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fourth month he went to Longhu Gate, called chief ministers, scholars, senior Gold Crow generals, and great generals to feast at Guanghua Monastery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，契丹遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On renshen Khitan envoys came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Khitan envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸宣威殿，宴文武官四品已上及軍使、蕃客。

translations.literal: On dingchou he visited Xuanwei Hall and feasted civil and military officials of fourth rank and above, army commissioners, and foreign guests.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou at Xuanwei Hall he feasted officials of fourth rank and above, army commissioners, and foreign guests.

sentences.zh: 己卯，又幸左龍軍，宴群臣。

translations.literal: On jimao he again visited the Left Dragon Army and feasted the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he again went to the Left Dragon Army and feasted the ministers.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「邠、岐未滅，關、隴多虞，宜擇親賢，總茲戎任。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Bin and Qi are not yet destroyed and Guan and Long are full of worry—it is fitting to choose a close worthy to take overall command of these military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Bin and Qi are not yet subdued and the northwest is troubled—choose a close worthy to command the frontier.

sentences.zh: 應關西同、雍、華、鄜、延、夏等六道兵馬，並委冀王收掌指揮。

translations.literal: All troops of the six western circuits—Tong, Yong, Hua, Fu, Yan, and Xia—are entrusted to Prince of Ji to receive and direct.
translations.idiomatic: All forces of the six western circuits—Tong, Yong, Hua, Fu, Yan, and Xia—are placed under Prince of Ji to command.

sentences.zh: 凡有抽差，先申西面都招討使，仍別奏聞，庶合機權，以甯邊鄙。」

translations.literal: Whenever detachments are drawn, report first to the western overall commander and also memorialize separately, so that authority may suit circumstance and secure the border."
translations.idiomatic: Any levy must be reported first to the western overall commander and then memorialized separately, so power fits need and the frontier is kept quiet."

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，帝被冕旒禦朝元殿視朝，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On jiashen, first day of the fifth month, the Emperor wore the crown and presided at Chaoyuan Hall for court, guards and escort as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the first of the fifth month, the Emperor wore the crown at Chaoyuan Hall for audience, guards and escort as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 制：改開平五年為乾化元年，大赦天下。

translations.literal: An edict: Kaiping year 5 was changed to Ganhua 1 and there was a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed Kaiping 5 to Ganhua 1 and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 詔方伯州牧，近未加恩者，並遷爵秩。

translations.literal: An edict: regional commissioners and prefects recently not yet favored were all promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commissioners and prefects not yet rewarded were all raised in rank.

sentences.zh: 復大賚軍旅，普宴于宣威殿，賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: The armies were again richly rewarded; a general feast was held at Xuanwei Hall and silk granted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The armies were rewarded again; a general feast at Xuanwei Hall and graded gifts of silk.

sentences.zh: 制：封延州節度使高萬興為渤海郡王。

translations.literal: An edict: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing was enfeoffed as Prince of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing was enfeoffed Prince of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 諸道節度使錢鏐、張宗奭、馬殷、王審知、劉隱各賜一子六品正員官，高季昌賜一子八品正員官，賀德倫賜一子九品正員官。

translations.literal: Circuit commissioners Qian Liu, Zhang Zongshi, Ma Yin, Wang Shenzhi, and Liu Yin each had one son given a regular sixth-rank post; Gao Jichang one son eighth rank; He Delun one son ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners Qian Liu, Zhang Zongshi, Ma Yin, Wang Shenzhi, and Liu Yin each received a regular sixth-rank post for a son; Gao Jichang an eighth-rank post; He Delun a ninth-rank post.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，觀稼于伊水，登建春門，幸會節坊張宗奭私第，臨亭皋視物色，賞賜甚厚。

translations.literal: On guisi he viewed the harvest on the Yi River, ascended Jianchun Gate, visited Zhang Zongshi’s private residence in Huijie Ward, overlooked the pavilion terrace to view the scenery, and rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he inspected crops on the Yi, climbed Jianchun Gate, visited Zhang Zongshi’s mansion in Huijie Ward, looked out from the pavilion over the landscape, and gave lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 詔左銀台門，朝參諸司使庫使已下，不得帶從人入城，親王許一二人執條床手簡，餘悉止門外，闌入者抵律。

translations.literal: An edict on the Left Silver Terrace Gate: officials attending court from commissioners and storekeepers downward must not bring attendants into the city; princes may have one or two carrying folding beds and hand tablets—all others stop outside the gate; violators are punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict on the Left Silver Terrace Gate: court officials from commissioners and storekeepers down might not bring attendants into the city. Princes might have one or two bearers with folding beds and tablets; all others halted outside. Intruders were punished by law.

sentences.zh: 閽守不禁，與所犯同。

translations.literal: Gate guards who do not stop them share the same offense.
translations.idiomatic: Guards who failed to stop them shared the offense.

sentences.zh: 先時，門通內無門籍，且多勳戚，車騎眾者，尤不敢呵察。

translations.literal: Earlier the gate communicated with the inner palace without gate registers, and there were many meritorious kin; those with large retinues of chariots and horses were especially not called to account.
translations.idiomatic: Before, the gate opened to the palace without registers, and many kinsmen of merit passed through; large retinues were rarely challenged.

sentences.zh: 至是有以客星淩犯上言者，遂令止隔。

translations.literal: Now because someone memorialized that a guest star was encroaching on the sovereign, he ordered the barrier enforced.
translations.idiomatic: When a memorial reported a guest star encroaching on the throne, he ordered the barrier enforced.

sentences.zh: 清海軍節度使、守侍中、兼中書令劉隱薨，輟朝三日，百僚詣閣門奉慰。

translations.literal: Qinghai military commissioner, acting palace attendant, and concurrent Secretariat director Liu Yin died; court was suspended three days and the hundred officials went to the Gate Department to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yin, Qinghai commissioner, acting palace attendant, and concurrent Secretariat director, died; court halted three days and officials offered condolences at the Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，命北面都招討使、鎮國軍節度使楊師厚出屯邢、洺。

translations.literal: On yimao of the sixth month he ordered overall northern commander and Zhenguo military commissioner Yang Shihou to encamp at Xing and Mo.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the sixth month he sent overall northern commander Yang Shihou, Zhenguo commissioner, to camp at Xing and Mo.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鎮、定鈔我湯陰。

translations.literal: On dingsi Zhen and Ding raided our Tangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Zhen and Ding forces raided Tangyin.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「常山背義，易水效尤，誘其蕃戎，動我邊鄙，南侵相、魏，東出邢、洺。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Changshan turned traitor and Yishui followed suit, enticing the frontier tribes and stirring our borderlands, invading south into Xiang and Wei and east out of Xing and Mo.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Changshan broke faith and Yishui copied it, rousing frontier tribes and stirring our borders, pushing south into Xiang and Wei and east toward Xing and Mo.

sentences.zh: 是用遣將徂征，為人除害，但初頒赦令，不欲食言，宥而伐之，諒非獲已。

translations.literal: Therefore I send generals on campaign to remove harm for the people—but having just proclaimed an amnesty I do not wish to break my word; to spare yet still attack is surely not my wish.
translations.idiomatic: I send generals to clear away harm—but we have just proclaimed an amnesty and I will not break my word; to pardon yet still strike is not what I desire.

sentences.zh: 況聞謀始，不自帥臣，致此厲階，並由奸佞。

translations.literal: Moreover I hear the plot did not begin with the commanders themselves; this evil stage was all due to treacherous minions.
translations.idiomatic: I hear the plot did not start with the commanders; this disaster came from treacherous advisers.

sentences.zh: 密通人使，潛結沙陀，既懼罪誅，乃生離叛。

translations.literal: They secretly sent envoys and quietly allied with the Shatuo; fearing punishment, they turned to rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: They sent secret envoys and allied with the Shatuo; fearing punishment, they rebelled.

sentences.zh: 今雖行討伐，已舉師徒，亦開詔諭之門，不阻歸降之路。

translations.literal: Though we now march to punish them and have already raised armies, we also open the gate of edicts and do not block the road of surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Though we march to punish them and armies are already raised, the door of edicts stays open and the road of surrender is not blocked.

sentences.zh: 矧又王熔、處直未曾削爵除名，若翻然改圖，不遠而復，必仍舊貫，當保前功。

translations.literal: Moreover Wang Rong and Chuzhi have not yet been stripped of rank and name—if they turn back and return not far off, they shall keep their old posts and preserve their former merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Rong and Chuzhi have not been stripped of rank; if they turn back soon, they keep their posts and their past merit.

sentences.zh: 如有率眾向明，拔州效順，亦行殊賞，冀徇來情，免令受弊於疲民，用示維新於汙俗。

translations.literal: If any lead the masses toward the light, seize a prefecture and show loyalty, special rewards will also be granted, hoping to meet their intent, lest the weary people suffer harm and to show renewal to a tainted land.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever leads men to submit, takes a prefecture, and proves loyal will receive special rewards, to spare the people and show renewal to a corrupted land.

sentences.zh: 宜令行營都招討使及陳暉軍前，准此敕文，散加招諭，將安眾懼，特舉明恩。

translations.literal: The campaign overall commander and Chen Hui before the army should follow this edict, distribute persuasion widely, calm the people’s fear, and specially proclaim clear grace.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign commander and Chen Hui at the front should circulate this edict, reassure the fearful, and proclaim mercy openly.

sentences.zh: 鎮州只罪李宏規一人，其餘一切不問。

translations.literal: At Zhenzhou only Li Honggui is guilty; all others are not questioned.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenzhou only Li Honggui is to be punished; all others go free.

sentences.zh: 」詔修天宮佛寺。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered repair of the Heavenly Palace Buddhist monastery.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Heavenly Palace Buddhist monastery repaired.

sentences.zh: 又，湖南奏：「潭州僧法思、桂州僧歸真並乞賜紫衣。

translations.literal: Also, Hunan reported: "Tanzhou monk Fasi and Guizhou monk Guizhen both beg purple robes.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan also reported: "The monks Fasi of Tanzhou and Guizhen of Guizhou both request purple robes.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 七月，帝不豫，稍厭秋暑。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Emperor was unwell and somewhat weary of the autumn heat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Emperor fell ill and grew weary of the autumn heat.

sentences.zh: 自辛丑幸會節坊張宗奭私第，宰臣視事於歸仁亭子，崇政使、內諸司及翰林院並止于河南令廨署，至甲辰，復歸大內。

translations.literal: From xinchou he visited Zhang Zongshi’s private residence in Huijie Ward; chief ministers conducted affairs at the Guiren Pavilion; Chongzheng commissioners, inner offices, and the Hanlin Academy all lodged at the Henan prefect’s yamen—until jiachen, when he returned to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: From xinchou he stayed at Zhang Zongshi’s mansion in Huijie Ward; chief ministers worked from Guiren Pavilion; Chongzheng staff, inner offices, and the Hanlin lodged at the Henan prefect’s offices until jiachen, when he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，幸保寧殿，閱天興控鶴兵事，軍使將校各有賜。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the eighth month he visited Baoning Hall, reviewed Tianxing Crane-Control Army affairs, and army commissioners and officers each received gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the eighth month he went to Baoning Hall, reviewed the Tianxing Crane-Control Army, and rewarded its commissioners and officers.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，老人星見。

translations.literal: On guihai the Old Man star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Old Man star appeared.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸故上陽宮，至於榆林觀稼。

translations.literal: On wuchen he visited the former Shangyang Palace and went on to Yulin to view the harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he went to the old Shangyang Palace and on to Yulin to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，閱四蕃將軍、屯衛兵士于天津橋，南至龍門廣化寺。

translations.literal: On bingzi he reviewed the Four Barbarian generals and garrison guards at Tianjin Bridge, south to Longmen’s Guanghua Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he reviewed Four Barbarian generals and garrison troops at Tianjin Bridge, south to Guanghua Monastery at Longmen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸興安鞠場大教閱，帝自指麾，無不踴抃，坐作進退，聲振宮掖。

translations.literal: On wuyin he visited Xing’an Ball Ground for a great review; the Emperor personally directed—none failed to leap and applaud; sitting, rising, advancing, and retreating shook the palace quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin at Xing’an Ball Ground he held a grand review and directed in person; the men leapt and cheered; drill movements shook the palace quarter.

sentences.zh: 右神武統軍丁審衢對禦，以紅帛囊劍擬乘輿物，帝曰：「宿將也。

translations.literal: Right Divine Martial commander-in-chief Ding Shenheng faced the throne, using red silk to wrap a sword as if toward the imperial carriage; the Emperor said: "An old general.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenheng, Right Divine Martial commander, faced the throne with a sword wrapped in red silk as if toward the imperial carriage. The Emperor said: "A veteran.
The source text here is lost.

sentences.zh: 睜恕之，以劉重霸代其任。

translations.literal: The Emperor forgave him and replaced him with Liu Chongba.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned him and put Liu Chongba in his place.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳朔，帝御文明殿，群臣入閣，刑法待制官各奏事。

translations.literal: On xinsi, first day of the ninth month, the Emperor presided at Wenhua Hall; the ministers entered the side hall; awaiting-appointment officials of penal law each reported on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the first of the ninth month, the Emperor held Wenhua Hall; ministers entered the side hall; penal-law awaiting-appointment officials each reported.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宴群臣于興安殿。

translations.literal: On jichou he feasted the ministers at Xing’an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he feasted the ministers at Xing’an Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，親禦六師，次於河陽。

translations.literal: On gengzi he personally led the Six Armies and halted at Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he personally led the Six Armies and stopped at Heyang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，至於衛州。

translations.literal: On jiachen he reached Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he reached Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至於宜溝，幸民劉達墅。

translations.literal: On yisi he reached Yigou and visited the farmhouse of Liu Da.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he reached Yigou and visited Liu Da’s farmhouse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至相州，賞左親騎指揮使張仙、右雲騎指揮使宋鐸，嘗身先陷陣，各賜帛。

translations.literal: On bingwu he reached Xiangzhou and rewarded Left Close Cavalry commander Zhang Xian and Right Cloud Cavalry commander Song Duo, who had led charges in person—each was granted silk.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu at Xiangzhou he rewarded Zhang Xian, Left Close Cavalry commander, and Song Duo, Right Cloud Cavalry commander, who had led charges in person, with silk each.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥朔，駐蹕於相州，宰臣洎文武從官並詣行宮起居。

translations.literal: On xinhai, first day of the tenth month, the imperial presence halted at Xiangzhou; chief ministers and civil and military followers all came to the traveling palace for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first of the tenth month, the court halted at Xiangzhou; chief ministers and the civil and military retinue attended at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 戶部郎中孔昌序齎留都百官冬朔起居表至自西京，諸道節度使、刺史、諸籓府留後，各以冬朔起居表來上。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue bureau director Kong Changxu brought the winter New Year audience memorial from the hundred officials left at the capital, arriving from the Western Capital; circuit commissioners, prefects, and frontier regents each sent winter New Year audience memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Changxu of the Revenue Bureau brought the winter audience memorial from officials left in the capital, from the Western Capital; commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent winter audience memorials.

sentences.zh: 制以郢王友圭充控鶴指揮使，諸軍都虞候閻寶為御營使。

translations.literal: An edict made Prince of Ying Yougui Crane-Control commander and army chief of staff Yan Bao imperial camp commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ying Yougui was made Crane-Control commander and Yan Bao, army chief of staff, imperial camp commissioner.

sentences.zh: 有司以立冬太廟薦享上言，詔丞相杜曉赴西都攝祭行事。

translations.literal: The relevant office reported on the Start-of-Winter ancestral offering; an edict ordered chief minister Du Xiao to go to the Western Capital to perform the rites as proxy.
translations.idiomatic: Offices reported on the Start-of-Winter ancestral rites; chief minister Du Xiao was sent to the Western Capital to officiate in proxy.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，閱武於州闉之南樓。

translations.literal: On guichou he reviewed troops on the south tower of the prefectural gate.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he reviewed troops on the south tower of the city gate.

sentences.zh: 左龍驤都教練使鄧季筠、魏博馬軍都指揮使何令稠、右廂馬軍都指揮使陳令勳，以部下馬瘦，並腰斬於軍門。

translations.literal: Left Dragon-Flying training commissioner Deng Jiyun, Weibo horse-army commander He Lingchou, and Right Wing horse-army commander Chen Lingxun—because their troops’ horses were thin—were all cut in two at the waist at the army gate.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Jiyun, Left Dragon-Flying trainer, He Lingchou, Weibo horse commander, and Chen Lingxun, Right Wing horse commander, were beheaded at the army gate because their horses were emaciated.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，將以其夕幸魏縣，命閣門使李鬱報宰臣，兼敕內外。

translations.literal: On jiayin, intending that evening to visit Weixian, he ordered Gate Commissioner Li Yu to inform the chief ministers and also edict inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, planning to visit Weixian that evening, he had Gate Commissioner Li Yu notify the chief ministers and issued an edict within and without.

sentences.zh: 是夜，車駕發軔於都署。

translations.literal: That night the imperial carriage set out from the prefectural headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: That night the imperial carriage departed the prefectural headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次洹水。

translations.literal: On yimao he halted at Huan River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he stopped at Huan River.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，至魏縣。

translations.literal: On bingchen he reached Weixian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he reached Weixian.

sentences.zh: 先鋒將黃文靖伏誅。

translations.literal: Vanguard general Huang Wenjing was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard Huang Wenjing was executed.

sentences.zh: 己未，帝御朝元門，以回鶻、吐蕃二大國首領入覲故也。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Emperor presided at Chaoyuan Gate because chieftains of the two great states of the Uyghurs and Tibet had come to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he held Chaoyuan Gate because Uyghur and Tibetan chieftains had come to audience.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，令諸軍指揮使及四蕃將軍賜食于行宮之外廡。

translations.literal: On guihai he ordered army commanders and Four Barbarian generals granted food in the outer corridors of the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he had army commanders and Four Barbarian generals fed in the outer corridors of the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸邑西之白龍潭以觀魚焉。

translations.literal: On wuchen he visited White Dragon Pool west of the county seat to view the fish.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he went to White Dragon Pool west of the county seat to watch the fish.

sentences.zh: 既而漁人獲巨魚以獻，帝命放之中流，從臣以帝有仁惻之心，皆相顧欣然。

translations.literal: Presently fishermen caught a huge fish and presented it; the Emperor ordered it released midstream; the followers, seeing the Emperor’s humane heart, looked at one another with pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Fishermen caught a great fish and presented it; the Emperor ordered it released midstream; his followers, seeing his compassion, exchanged pleased glances.

sentences.zh: 是日，名其潭曰萬歲潭。

translations.literal: That day the pool was named Long-Life Pool.
translations.idiomatic: That day the pool was named Long-Life Pool.

sentences.zh: 丙子，帝御城東教場閱兵，諸軍都指揮、北面招討使、太尉楊師厚總領鐵馬步甲十萬，廣亙十數里陳焉。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Emperor reviewed troops at the east-city drill ground; army commander and northern commander-in-chief and Grand Marshal Yang Shihou commanded one hundred thousand iron cavalry and infantry arrayed for more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi at the east-city drill ground the Emperor reviewed troops; Yang Shihou, army commander, northern commander, and grand marshal, led one hundred thousand horse and foot in a line more than ten li long.

sentences.zh: 士卒之雄銳，部隊之嚴肅，旌旗之雜遝，戈甲之照耀，屹若山嶽，勢動天地，帝甚悅焉。

translations.literal: The soldiers’ fierceness, the units’ discipline, the banners’ profusion, and the arms’ gleam stood like mountains; the momentum moved heaven and earth—the Emperor was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were fierce, formations strict, banners dense, arms bright—like mountains, shaking heaven and earth. The Emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 即令丞相洎文武從臣列侍賜食，逮晚方歸。

translations.literal: He immediately ordered the chief minister and civil and military followers to stand in ranks and receive granted food; only at evening did they return.
translations.idiomatic: He had chief ministers and the retinue stand in ranks to receive food and only returned at evening.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳朔，上駐蹕魏縣，從官自丞相而下並詣行宮起居，留都文武百官及諸道節度使、防禦使、刺史、諸籓府留後，各奉表起居。

translations.literal: On xinsi, first day of the eleventh month, the sovereign halted at Weixian; followers from the chief minister down all attended at the traveling palace; officials left in the capital and circuit commissioners, defense commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent audience memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the first of the eleventh month, the court halted at Weixian; the retinue from the chief minister down attended; capital officials and commissioners, defense commissioners, prefects, and regents each sent audience memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，帝以邊事稍息，宣命還京師。

translations.literal: On renwu the Emperor, because frontier affairs had eased somewhat, proclaimed orders to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, with the frontier somewhat quieter, he ordered the return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 《通鑒》：帝以夾寨、柏鄉屢失利，故力疾北巡，思一雪其恥，意鬱鬱，多躁忿，功臣宿將往往以小過被誅，眾心益懼。

translations.literal: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Because the Emperor had repeatedly lost at Fortified Camp and Baixiang, he forced himself north on tour though ill, thinking to wipe away the shame; his mood was depressed and he was often irritable and angry; meritorious old generals were often executed for small faults and hearts grew more fearful.
translations.idiomatic: 《Zizhi Tongjian》: After repeated defeats at Fortified Camp and Baixiang, he forced himself north though ill to redeem the shame; brooding and quick to rage, he often killed veteran generals for small faults, and fear spread.

sentences.zh: 既而晉、趙兵不出。

translations.literal: Presently the Jin and Zhao armies did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin and Zhao armies never appeared.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，帝南還。

translations.literal: On renwu of the eleventh month the Emperor returned south.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the eleventh month the Emperor turned south.

sentences.zh: 車駕發自行闕，夕次洹水縣。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage set out from the traveling palace and in the evening halted at Huan River county.
translations.idiomatic: The court left the traveling palace and that evening stopped at Huan River county.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至內黃縣。

translations.literal: On guiwei he reached Neihuang county.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he reached Neihuang county.

sentences.zh: 甲申，至黎陽縣。

translations.literal: On jiashen he reached Liyang county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he reached Liyang county.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，命從官丞相而下宴於行次。

translations.literal: On yiyou he ordered followers from the chief minister down to feast at the halt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he feasted the retinue from the chief minister down at the halt.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，次衛州。

translations.literal: On dinghai he halted at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he stopped at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子晨，次新鄉，夕止獲嘉。

translations.literal: On wuzi at dawn he halted at Xinxiang; in the evening he stopped at Huojia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi at dawn he stopped at Xinxiang; by evening he was at Huojia.

sentences.zh: 己丑，次武陟。

translations.literal: On jichou he halted at Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he stopped at Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，次溫縣。

translations.literal: On gengyin he halted at Wen county.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he stopped at Wen county.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使高萬興奏，當軍都指揮使高萬金統領兵士，今月五日收鹽州，偽刺史高行存泥首來降。

translations.literal: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing reported that army commander Gao Wanjin led troops and on the fifth of this month took Yanzhou; the false prefect Gao Xingcun came bound to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Wanxing of Yanzhou reported that Gao Wanjin, army commander, took Yanzhou on the fifth of the month; the puppet prefect Gao Xingcun came in bonds to surrender.

sentences.zh: 丞相及文武百官各上表稱賀。

translations.literal: The chief minister and civil and military officials each submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers and officials each submitted congratulations.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，次孟州，命散騎常侍孫騭、右諫議大夫張衍、光祿卿李翼各齎香、祝版，告祭于孟津之望祠。

translations.literal: On xinmao he halted at Mengzhou and ordered Regular Attendant Sun Zhi, Right Reminder Zhang Yan, and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Yi each to carry incense and prayer boards to offer sacrifice at the Wang Shrine on the Meng Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao at Mengzhou he sent Regular Attendant Sun Zhi, Right Reminder Zhang Yan, and Sacrifices Director Li Yi with incense and prayer boards to sacrifice at the Wang Shrine on the Meng Ford.

sentences.zh: 留都文武官左僕射楊涉洎孟州守李周彝等皆匍匐東郊迎拜，其文武官並令先還。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Yang She of the capital officials and Mengzhou defender Li Zhouyi and others all prostrated themselves in the eastern suburbs to welcome and bow; the civil and military officials were all ordered to return first.
translations.idiomatic: Yang She, left vice director, Li Zhouyi, Mengzhou defender, and other capital officials prostrated themselves in the eastern suburbs to welcome him; civil and military officials were sent back first.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詰旦離孟州，晚至都。

translations.literal: On renchen at dawn he left Mengzhou and in the evening reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he left Mengzhou at dawn and reached the capital by evening.

sentences.zh: 宣宰臣各赴望祠禱雨。

translations.literal: Chief ministers were announced to go each to the Wang Shrine to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers were ordered each to the Wang Shrine to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 故事，皆以兩省無功職事為之，帝憂民重農，尤以足食足兵為念，爰自御極，每愆阳积阴，多命丞相躬其事。

translations.literal: By precedent this was always done by idle posts in the two departments without merit; the Emperor cared for the people and valued farming, especially mindful of full bellies and full armies—since taking the throne, whenever drought or long yin accumulated, he often ordered the chief minister to perform it in person.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent idle posts in the two departments handled it; the Emperor cared for the people and farming, mindful above all of full granaries and full ranks—since his accession, whenever drought or long gloom lingered, he often sent the chief minister in person.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大雨雪，宰臣及文武师长各奉表贺焉。

translations.literal: On xinchou there was heavy rain and snow; chief ministers and civil and military chiefs each submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou came heavy rain and snow; chief ministers and military chiefs each sent congratulations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔以時雪稍愆，命丞相及三省官各詣望祠祈禱。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict stated that timely snow was somewhat lacking and ordered the chief minister and Three Departments officials each to go to the Wang Shrine to pray.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, with timely snow scarce, the chief minister and Three Departments officials were each sent to the Wang Shrine to pray.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，臘假，詔諸王與河南尹、左右金吾、六統軍等較獵于近苑。

translations.literal: On guiyou, on the La holiday, an edict ordered the princes with the Henan prefect, Left and Right Gold Crow, and the six army commanders-in-chief to compete in hunting in the nearby park.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, La holiday, princes, the Henan prefect, the Gold Crow commanders, and the six army commanders were ordered to hunt together in the nearby park.

sentences.zh: 命大理卿王鄯使于安南，左散騎常侍吳藹使於朗州，皆以旌節官誥錫之也。

translations.literal: He appointed Court of Judicial Review director Wang Shan envoy to Annan and Left Regular Attendant Wu Ai envoy to Langzhou—both were granted banners of authority and commission patents.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shan, judicial review director, was sent to Annan and Wu Ai, left regular attendant, to Langzhou, each with banners of authority and commission patents.

sentences.zh: 又命將作少監薑宏道為朗州旌節官使副。

translations.literal: He also appointed Directorate of Works vice-director Jiang Hongdao deputy banner envoy to Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Hongdao, works vice-director, was made deputy banner envoy to Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 《五代會要》：舊制，巡撫、黜陟、冊命、吊贈、入蕃等使，選朝臣為之，其宣慰、加官、送旌節，即以中官為之，今以三品送旌節，新例也。

translations.literal: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: By old rule, inspection, promotion and demotion, investiture, condolence, and entry to foreign lands envoys were chosen from court officials; consolation, promotion, and delivery of banners of authority were given to eunuchs—now third-rank officials deliver banners, a new precedent.
translations.idiomatic: 《Five Dynasties Huiyao》: By old custom, inspection, promotion and demotion, investiture, condolence, and missions abroad went to court officials; consolation, promotion, and delivery of banners went to eunuchs—now third-rank officials carry banners, a new rule.

sentences.zh: 延州節度使高萬興奏，領軍於邠州界蒿子谷韋家寨，殺戮甯、慶兩州賊軍約二千餘人，並生擒都頭指揮使及奪馬器甲等事。

translations.literal: Yanzhou commissioner Gao Wanxing reported leading troops at Weijia Stockade in Haozi Valley on the Binzhou border, killing about two thousand bandit troops of Ning and Qing prefectures, and capturing bandit commanders alive along with seized horses, armor, and gear.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Wanxing reported a raid at Weijia Stockade in Haozi Valley on the Bin border, killing some two thousand bandits of Ning and Qing and capturing commanders with horses, armor, and gear.

sentences.zh: 其入奏軍將使宣召赴內殿賜對，以銀器彩物錫之，宰臣及文武官各奉表賀。

translations.literal: The reporting army officer was announced and summoned to audience in the inner hall and granted silver vessels and colored goods; chief ministers and civil and military officials each submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: The reporting officer was summoned to the inner hall and given silver and silks; chief ministers and officials sent congratulations.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏博節度上言，於涇縣北戮殺鎮州王熔兵士七千餘人，奪馬二千餘匹，戈甲未知其數，並擒都將以下四十餘人。

translations.literal: That month Weibo’s commissioner reported that north of Jing county he slaughtered more than seven thousand of Wang Rong’s Zhenzhou soldiers, seized more than two thousand horses, armor in unknown quantity, and captured more than forty commanders and below.
translations.idiomatic: That month Weibo reported slaughtering more than seven thousand of Wang Rong’s men north of Jing county, seizing two thousand horses, armor in unknown quantity, and forty-odd commanders.

sentences.zh: 兩浙進大方茶二萬斤，琢畫宮衣五百副。

translations.literal: The two Zhes presented twenty thousand jin of large-block tea and five hundred sets of carved palace robes.
translations.idiomatic: The two Zhes sent twenty thousand jin of brick tea and five hundred sets of carved palace robes.

sentences.zh: 廣州貢犀象奇珍及金銀等，其估數千萬。

translations.literal: Guangzhou offered rhinoceros horn, elephant ivory, rare treasures, and gold and silver worth tens of millions by estimate.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou sent rhinoceros horn, ivory, rarities, and gold and silver estimated in the tens of millions.

sentences.zh: 安南兩使留後曲美，《通鑒》：十二月戊午，以靜海、曲美為節度使。

translations.literal: Annan’s two envoys and regent Qu Mei—《Zizhi Tongjian》: On wuwu of the twelfth month Jinghai’s Qu Mei was made military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Annan’s envoys and regent Qu Mei—《Zizhi Tongjian》: On wuwu of the twelfth month Qu Mei of Jinghai was made military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 進筒中蕉五百匹，龍腦、郁金各五瓶，他海貨等有差。

translations.literal: He presented five hundred bolts of tube-rolled plantain, five jars each of borneol and turmeric, and other sea goods in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He presented five hundred bolts of tube-rolled plantain, five jars each of borneol and turmeric, and other overseas goods in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 又進南蠻通好金器六物、銀器十二並乾陁綾花繓棖越啉毛等雜織奇巧者各三十件。

translations.literal: Also presented six gold vessels and twelve silver vessels for southern barbarian friendship, and thirty each of ganduo brocade, huajiao, bing, yueling, and other exotic woven goods.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent six gold and twelve silver friendship vessels from the south, and thirty each of ganduo brocade, huajiao, bing, yueling, and other exotic textiles.

sentences.zh: 福建進戶部所支榷課葛三萬五千匹。

translations.literal: Fujian presented thirty-five thousand bolts of monopoly-tax ramie cloth paid by the Revenue Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian presented thirty-five thousand bolts of Revenue Ministry monopoly ramie cloth.
